name: OBS Status & Guard
author: borferkic
description: Shows an ON AIR pill with the stream time while OBS is live, warns on screen if OBS closes abruptly while streaming, and can reopen OBS and resume the stream.

barWidget.description: ON AIR indicator with stream time, and a warning if OBS closes while streaming

schema.label: Monitor OBS (turn off to pause the status pill, alerts and auto-reopen)
Reopen OBS and resume streaming automatically after it closes abruptly
Play a sound when OBS closes abruptly
Custom alert sound file (blank uses the built-in alarm)
Monitor for the warning (e.g. DP-5; blank uses the largest monitor)
Monitor where OBS reopens (e.g. HDMI-A-1; blank leaves it wherever it opens)
